title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mjcp: fragments_in_window_vec uses modulo instead of absolute window
description:
fragments_in_window_vec filters with `f.window == (abs_window % 2) as u8`, but Fragment.window stores the absolute window number (from `index / WINDOW_SIZE`), not the modulo-2 parity. With current constants (MAX_PACKET_SIZE=16384, TILE_SIZE=187 → max 88 tiles → max 2 windows) this works correctly because abs_window values 0 and 1 have unique parity values. However, if WINDOW_SIZE decreases or TILE_SIZE increases such that packets span 3+ windows, abs_window=2 would have parity 0 (same as window 0), causing fragments_in_window_vec(2) to return fragments from window 0 instead of window 2. The correct filter should be `f.window == abs_window as u8`.

Fix: Change `f.window == (abs_window % 2) as u8` to `f.window == abs_window as u8` for semantic correctness and robustness against future constant changes.
